title: Kira Went Live On TV And Killed A Man In Front Of The Whole World . . . (highlight)
caption:
Kira goes live on TV and kills a man on camera. Full recap is on our page 👉 link in the comments

#deathnote #anime #animerecap #animeexplained #fyp

segments.say: Kira goes live on TV, kills a man on camera, and a cop drops dead at the station *door*.
A TV station says it has four tapes, sent straight from *Kira*.
Tape two airs live at six, and the whole task force holds its *breath*.
Then the screen flickers, and one word fills it. *KIRA*.
He orders the station to change channels. At six sharp, a news anchor on another network will *die*.
The clock hits six, and the whole room goes *silent*.
On the other channel, the anchor grabs his chest and *collapses*.
Nobody says a word. Even L looks *shaken*.
Then Kira names his next victim, and L flips to *channel 24* to see.
But nobody at the station answers. So a young detective, Ukita, takes a siren and *drives*.
Outside Sakura TV, Ukita jumps out of the car, gun in *hand*.
His gun hits the ground. Kira just *killed* him.
